headline: TBR @ BAL matchup research

Batter research is strongest for Junior Caminero, Yandy Díaz, Richie Palacios, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Tyler O'Neill because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
